parts.title: Photographs

paragraphs.text: Directions: For each question in this part, you will hear four statements about a picture in your test book. When you hear the statements, you must select the one statement that best describes what you see in the picture. Then find the number of the question on your answer sheet and mark your answer. The statements will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.

parts.title: Conversations
parts.instructions: Select the best response to each question.

paragraphs.text: Directions: You will hear some conversations between two or more people. You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speakers say in each conversation. Select the best response to each question and mark the letter (A), (B), (C), or (D) on your answer sheet. The conversations will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.

questions.prompt: Why has the man come to see the woman?

options.label: To sign up for a sales meeting
To pick up a paper form
To ask about a payment deadline
To turn in expenses from a trip

questions.prompt: According to the woman, what has recently changed?

options.label: The way expense claims are filed
The date expense claims are due

questions.prompt: What does the man say he will do before he leaves today?

options.label: Leave the paper copies with her
Submit the claim on his own
Have a coworker enter the claim

questions.prompt: Why is the woman calling?

options.label: To reserve equipment for a group trip
To ask for directions to the lake

questions.prompt: What problem does the man mention?
What does the man offer to do?

options.label: Provide a different type of boat

questions.prompt: Who most likely is the woman?
What does the man say he needs to do?

options.label: Reach a place by a set time

questions.prompt: What does the woman offer to do?

options.label: Book him on an earlier boat

parts.title: Talks
parts.instructions: Select the best response to each question.

paragraphs.text: Directions: You will hear some talks given by a single speaker. You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speaker says in each talk. Select the best response to each question and mark the letter (A), (B), (C), or (D) on your answer sheet. The talks will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.

questions.prompt: What is the speaker mainly discussing?
What did some customers complain about?
What does the speaker suggest doing?
What does the speaker say about the salon's groomers?

options.label: They are professionally qualified and experienced.
They are available seven days a week.
They will travel to customers' homes.
They can groom any type of animal.

questions.prompt: According to the speaker, what do first-time customers receive?
What does the speaker urge listeners to do?

options.label: Book a visit through the website
Sign up for a rewards program
Call to reserve a time slot

questions.prompt: What is the course mainly about?
What does the speaker ask the listeners to do before the next class?
Why does the speaker say, "I struggled with this myself when I first started"?
What kind of business is being reported on?
Why is the business relocating?
How does the speaker suggest listeners take part?
Where most likely are the listeners?
According to the speaker, why is the step important?

options.label: It lets clinical staff know a patient has arrived.
It reduces the time patients spend waiting.
It ensures patients are satisfied with their visit.

questions.prompt: What will the listeners most likely do next?
What type of business does the speaker work for?
What did the speaker find out yesterday?

options.label: A product has won an award.
A store has opened a new location.
Demand for a product has increased.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "these units tend to sell out quickly"?

options.label: He would like to give the listener a discount.
He needs to hire additional staff.
He wants the listener to place an order soon.
He is concerned about a shipping error.

questions.prompt: What has the listener recently done?
According to the speaker, what is one advantage of the facility?

options.label: It keeps items at a stable temperature.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker recommend?

options.label: Entering a code at the gate.

questions.prompt: What is the broadcast mainly about?

options.label: A new exhibition at a museum.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say is unusual about the exhibition?

options.label: The photographs were all taken recently.
The works were created by many artists.
Many of the photographs were taken underwater.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "it only runs through the end of the month"?

options.label: To encourage listeners to visit soon.
